note: Two of the three genuinely affected call sites produced nothing. Those two are false negatives -- what recall exists to count -- and not exclusions: they belong in recall's denominator (3) and nowhere in precision's (2). Reading them as unscoreable is what produces a recall of 1.0 on any input, so the numbers are chosen so that mistake is visible: recall 1/3 against precision 1/2, both away from 1.0 and from each other.
